turns.text: real quick i need to pick a pic of me and jade to send her. i have to head out for the 9pm overtime shift soon so short version pls
Got it, quick version. Tell me what photos you're choosing between, or describe them, and I'll help you pick one and suggest a light edit. What's the vibe you want it to send?

its kind of an apology. ive been sleeping thru her days off all week and she's over it lol. want it to say i miss her without being weird. i got a few options, one from a saturday dinner at pho ben thanh, one at the park, one selfie where my eyes are half shut

Go with the pho dinner photo. It's a shared moment, and a Saturday dinner shot says 'I remember our time together' better than a selfie would. The park pic is a solid backup. Skip the half-shut-eyes selfie, unless you're sending it as a joke.

Quick edit: crop tight on the two of you, brighten the exposure slightly, and warm the tone a bit so restaurant lighting doesn't look yellow-green. No filters.

Caption: "Missed you this week. Sorry I keep sleeping through your days off. Let me make it up to you Saturday."
ok thats kinda corny fr. less corny

2. "Miss you. I owe you some awake hours."
3. "This was a good night. Let's do another one soon."

Want it shorter, or more direct?
